content_blocks.label: clause_1._Notice_to_Vacate
content_blocks.text: You are hereby notified that you are in violation of the terms of your lease and are required to vacate the premises immediately.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Reason_for_Eviction
content_blocks.text: The reason for this eviction notice is the failure to pay rent as required by the lease agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Time_to_Vacate
content_blocks.text: You have thirty (30) days from the date of this notice to vacate the premises.
